name: Mount Rainier National Park
policyReason: Pets are banned from all trails except the Pacific Crest Trail; roads, parking lots and campgrounds are fine.
summary: Pets are banned from all trails except the Pacific Crest Trail; roads, parking lots and campgrounds are fine.

excerpts.quote: Dogs on a leash no longer than 6 feet are permitted on the Pacific Crest Trail.

dogRules.text: Not on trails, wilderness, buildings, amphitheaters, winter-closed roads or snow.
The Pacific Crest Trail is the one exception.
